summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config 14.3.4 ships preinstall dropper fetching Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The 14.3.4 release of @ornikar/monorepo-config adds a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs` in package.json) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 728 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and containing a string-array/dispatcher rotator with no readable identifiers. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated with hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-dictionary indirection. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is referenced by the package's declared `main`, its bin scripts, or its lib/ modules — the package's advertised purpose is monorepo workspace/eslint/tsconfig config sharing, which has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque adjacent payload. Using Bun rather than the already-present Node runtime executes the payload under a fresh, un-instrumented runtime and evades Node-based install-time inspection. The composition (legitimate maintainer content plus a grafted-on preinstall and unrelated obfuscated bundle) is consistent with a compromised release rather than an intentional feature.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
